- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6102 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The shell fallback uses `false` when `ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS` is unset.
  WHY: According to README.md documentation, the default should be `true` ("Set to `false` to opt out of auto-updates"). This means when a consumer repository does not configure the `ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS` variable, workflow edits will be blocked instead of allowed.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:411 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The workflow passes `'false'` as the fallback when the repository variable is unset.
  WHY: The documented default is `true`, so this should pass `'true'` as the fallback instead. When the repository variable is not set, the orchestrator sets `ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS=false` in the environment, which then gets forwarded to dispatched review workflows as `-f allow_workflow_edits=false`, blocking workflow edits by default.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8057 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When `ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS` is unset, this condition evaluates to `false`, causing the script to take the else branch that excludes workflow-related files from staging.
  WHY: This contradicts the documented default of allowing edits. Workflow files (.github/workflows/, scripts/, prompts/, .github/ai/) will be excluded from staging even though the documented default is to allow them.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8077 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When `ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS` is unset, the condition `${ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS:-false} != "true"` evaluates to `true`.
  WHY: This causes the guard to incorrectly error on staged workflow files even though the intent is to allow edits by default. When the variable is unset, the script will error out if any workflow-related files are staged, blocking legitimate commits.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8057 and 8077 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Wrong fallback value in both workflow-edit guards.
  WHY: If a repository relies on the documented default (`true`), these guards would incorrectly take the "workflow edits disabled" path.
